project_analysis.summary: A global language-learning platform providing gamified lessons, exercises, and progress tracking through interactive content.
project_analysis.main_purpose: To provide an engaging, accessible, and effective way for users to learn new languages through bite-sized lessons.
expected_user_journey: Sign up/Login -> Select language -> Complete introductory lesson -> View progress/streak -> Earn XP/Rewards -> Upgrade to Premium

smoke_tests: Application load and landing page availability
Core navigation between dashboard and lessons
boundary_tests: Maximum character limits in user profile
Input validation for text-based translation exercises
negative_tests: Interrupted internet connection during a lesson
accessibility_tests: WCAG 2.1 compliance for lesson interactive elements
Screen reader compatibility for audio exercises
integration_tests: User progress sync between web and mobile platforms
Payment gateway integration with user account
Leaderboard updates based on lesson completion
system_tests: End-to-end user journey from registration to lesson completion
Real-time synchronization of XP and streaks
ui_tests: Visual consistency of gamified icons and progress bars
Responsive design across different screen sizes
exploratory_tests: Unconventional navigation paths through the learning tree
Rapid interaction with lesson elements to test race conditions
Testing various input types (audio, text, multiple choice)
security_tests: Protection of user progress data integrity
performance_test_suggestions: Load testing during peak usage hours

explorer_summary.summary: Duolingo is a language‑learning platform that offers interactive lessons, games, and stories to help users acquire new languages. The homepage features a prominent hero section with a call‑to‑action to sign up, a language selector, and a top navigation bar linking to sections such as Learn, Practice, Stories, Games, and Community. Users typically start by signing up or logging in, choose a target language, and then proceed to the lesson interface. The site uses modern web technologies and analytics tools to track engagement and improve the learning experience.

navigation_analysis.navigation_flow: Home page presents a hero section with a sign‑up CTA, a language selector, and top navigation links to Learn, Practice, Stories, Games, and Community. Users usually sign up or log in, select a target language, and then move to the lesson interface. The flow is linear from home to account creation to language selection to lesson content.
